blind.description: A medieval heater-style heraldic shield standing upright on its bottom tip. The front face features a wooden board bordered with a golden/brass trim, painted in a red-and-white (or cream) checkered pattern crossed diagonally by an orange/red bend (diagonal stripe), framed by a thick wooden outer rim. The back face reveals the curved wooden plank construction and two brown leather forearm/grip straps. The entire model is solid, manifold, and continuous with no hovering fragments or melted parts.
blind.from_above: Seen from directly overhead, it appears as a thin, gently curved horizontal arc with a brown wooden backing and a gold/red crest protruding slightly forward, casting an upright shield-shaped shadow onto the ground to its side.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 feet tall and 2 feet wide, reaching slightly below the waist of the 5 ft 9 in figure.

notes: Includes shield arm straps on the rear rather than flat wall mounting hardware
